title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. translated_title: 非洲论文集：面向非洲基础语言模型的百亿 token 多领域学术语料库
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）从根本上依赖于预训练语料库的多样性、深度和事实严谨性。然而，当代基础预训练数据集（如 The Pile、S2ORC 和 Dolma）存在严重的结构性缺失：非洲的科学、医学、法律和农业学术文献在全球预训练 token 中占比不足 0.5%。因此，最先进的模型在对热带流行病学、本地化小农农业生态、区域经济治理以及本土语言结构进行推理时会出现系统性的失效模式。为解决这一表征缺失问题并推进非洲在人工智能领域的知识主权，我们推出了 Africa-Papers——迄今规模最大的经过整理的泛非多领域学术预训练语料库。该语料库包含超过 844,807 篇全文论文，共计 101.5 亿个 token，分布于 879 个 Parquet 分片中，统一整合了……
tldr: 本文发布了迄今最大的泛非多领域学术预训练语料库 Africa-Papers，包含 84 万余篇全文论文、共计 101.5 亿个 token，旨在弥补现有大模型预训练数据中非洲学术内容占比不足 0.5% 的结构性缺失，提升模型对非洲相关领域的理解能力并推进非洲的 AI 知识主权。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Africa-Papers, the largest curated Pan-African multi-domain academic pre-training corpus to date, comprising over 844,807 full-text papers and 10.15 billion tokens, designed to address the severe underrepresentation (<0.5%) of African scholarship in existing LLM pre-training datasets and advance African intellectual sovereignty in AI.
